effect.en: Blocks damaging attacks and lowers attacking Pokémon’s Attack by two stages on contact.  Switches Aegislash to Shield Forme.

flavor.ko: 상대의 공격을 막음과 동시에 방어 태세를 갖춘다. 접촉한 상대의 공격을 떨어뜨린다.
flavor.en: The user takes a defensive stance while it protects itself from damage. It also lowers the Attack stat of any attacker that makes direct contact.
